comparison.objective: Fill a steam-table well with pans leaving no opening, versus break and recover insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-pan placement and spatial packing versus millimetre-scale tool alignment, bimanual impact control, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: A completely covered well versus four fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Packing/coverage and controlled notch fracture test different abilities. Exact coverage tolerances and handling constraints are absent.
